notes.title: Fat Baby update - New ability and more content !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are all enjoying Fat Baby so far! We've got some new and exciting content to share with you.


[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]

- Added a new cannonball ability 
- Added the ability to break buildings and eat them
- Added skins that are unlockable through the amount of games won  
- Added top hat, monocle and tuxedo skins
- Fences are now breakable and edible 
- Added an optimization tab in the settings  

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

- Fixed hunt mode crashing the game 
- Fixed baby clipping through buildings 
- Added quality of life changes for people getting stuck on fences, etc ..
- Made it so cars and leaf blowers cant ragdoll you when you get big enough
- Some optimization to make the game run smoother 
- Nerfed the kids ability to bully babies

[u][b]What's to come:[/b][/u]

- Single-player 
- New skins 
- Access to the city
- More destructible objects 


We just wanted to say thanks to all of you for your patience, we are currently focused on getting new content out in a fast(-er) and efficient manner.

Hope you guys enjoy!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug where hunting ability would crash game for players playing solo when the ability ended
-Fixed issue where players could randomly fall through the map

notes.title: Some bug fixes and what's to come with Fat Baby
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

We just wanted to say thank you to everyone who purchased the game post release and thank you to everyone who has left us feedback on the game. We're addressing some of the bugs that have been encountered and happy to say we've got some big plans for the future of Fat Baby. 

We are currently working on adding a single-player mode where you can battle against selected enemies and destroy more of the game environment. If there is anything that you would like to see added in futures updates please visit our[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1825740/discussions/3/3198117312262576413/] community hub[/url] and leave us some suggestions.

Thank you and merry Christmas !

notes.title: Fat Baby Christmas eve release !
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

just wanted to announce that Fat Baby is finally ready for release just in time for Christmas! This is our first Steam game and we want it to be a driven by the community so please leave us some feedback on our community hub page, or contact us directly via our twitter. 

If you run in to any issues (bugs, etc..) please contact us via our support email or leave us a post on our bug reporting section on the Fat Baby community hub.

We look forward to the future of our game and the community behind it!

Thank you & Merry Christmas!
